subject.title: improve: let Code Mode use declared tool result shapes

question: Should `AgentTool.outputSchema` become the supported optional plugin API for result hints and runtime validation across Code Mode and Tool Search?
rationale: The branch establishes a new externally consumable plugin contract and trust policy; tests can verify an implementation, but they cannot choose the long-term API semantics or ownership boundary.

options.title: Approve after renderer fix
options.body: Adopt the optional contract after unrenderable unions fail closed and exact-head compatibility, transcript, and trust-boundary proof passes.

options.title: Keep it experimental
options.body: Restrict the metadata to internal tools until external plugin semantics, versioning, and migration expectations are settled.

options.title: Retain unknown outputs
options.body: Decline the API and preserve the current raw-first behavior for every tool result.

recommendation.title: Approve after renderer fix
recommendation.body: Adopt the optional contract after unrenderable unions fail closed and exact-head compatibility, transcript, and trust-boundary proof passes.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main Code Mode behavior and this proposed API direction are direct continuations of this person's merged feature work and listed ownership area.
